name: supplier-feed-import
description: Takes a supplier's price and stock feed sent to a webhook, matches each row to your products, proposes the price and stock updates for approval and reports what changed.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: The supplier's system, or your integration, posts the feed to a webhook

howItWorks.label: Matches
howItWorks.text: Each row to a product by SKU or the supplier's item code

howItWorks.label: Updates
howItWorks.text: Stock and cost, and optionally the selling price, only where they changed

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve the updates, with unusual changes called out

howItWorks.label: Reports
howItWorks.text: What changed, what was skipped and which rows did not match

plugins.reason: Posts the import report to a channel

data.description: The product's SKU, to match feed rows
The quantity on hand, updated from the feed
What the product costs the store, updated from the supplier's price
The selling price, updated only when price updates are on
The supplier's own item code, when it differs from the store's SKU
The supplier the product is bought from, so rows only update that supplier's products

parameters.label: Supplier
parameters.description: The supplier this feed comes from; leave empty when one feed covers every product

parameters.label: Match rows by
parameters.description: Which field of the feed identifies the product

parameters.label: Update selling prices
parameters.description: When off, only stock and cost are updated; the selling price stays as you set it

parameters.label: Call out cost or price changes above (%)
parameters.description: Changes bigger than this are listed first in the approval and the report

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Optional; where the import report is posted
